phone/landing:
LINEREAPER
PICK'EM APPS, KALSHI, POLYMARKET US AND ESPORTS
Made for sharps,
by sharps.

A price that moved before you could click is not an edge. Line Reaper grades every alert on whether you could still get the price two minutes after it fired, by signal and venue, and keeps the whole record public, losers included. Signals that fail the test stop alerting.

Start free
See the record

No card needed for the free plan. 21+ where legal.

THE LIVE RECORD
READ FROM THE APP
0
Alerts graded so far
-
Beat the close at the alert
0
Plays proven by the record
Plays on the board right now
201

124
Every number here reads live from the app, losers included. A play counts as proven only once 50 graded bets beat the close and its results are not running short of it. Beating the close is not a promise of profit.
01 / PRODUCT
Everything a sharp checks before betting, on one screen.

Built for prediction exchanges and esports, the two markets the big odds screeners mostly ignore.

EXCHANGE EDGES
Graded on the price you could actually get.

Line Reaper reads the deep book's fair price, adds each venue's fee, and flags Kalshi and Polymarket US prices that lag it. Most screeners stop there. We then check the price one, two and five minutes after the alert, because that is what a subscriber really gets.

Every alert graded at the moment it fired and again two minutes later
Record cut by signal and venue, losers included, all public
A signal alerts only after its own two-minute record is positive
Signals that don't hold up are held back and say so
BEST PLAYS
One ranked list.

The strongest plays across every tool, ranked by what the track record says is working. Plays the record says to avoid never make the list.

ARBS AND MIDDLES
Locked profit, fees included.

Cross-exchange and multi-outcome arbitrage, middles on totals and spreads, and bid-then-hedge plans that turn a resting order into an arb.

ODDS SCREEN
Every venue on one row.

Pinnacle's no-vig fair next to Kalshi, Polymarket US, Gemini, FanDuel, BetRivers and the big books on every game, the best price marked, and a chart of how each line moved. One tap shows only the venues legal in Texas.

SHARP TAIL
See what the biggest accounts bet.

Polymarket trades are public, so we grade accounts on return, sample size and a luck test, and watch Kalshi for whale-sized orders. Following them has not beaten the close in our own tests, and its record says so: it is a research tool, not a signal to copy.

ESPORTS
Every prop, every app, priced.

CS2, League of Legends, Valorant and Dota 2 props, and the sports boards, across PrizePicks, Underdog, Sleeper and DK Pick6, priced against Pinnacle and the books, with what each slip pays and needs to break even.

TOOLS AND MY BETS
The math, done for you.

Thirteen calculators: EV and Kelly, no-vig, arbs, hedges, middles, parlays, free bets, boosts, CLV, exchange fees and every pick'em app's payouts and break-even. Log your bets and slips and see your CLV.

ALERTS
On your phone.

Add Line Reaper to your home screen and turn on push alerts, so a play reaches you before the market moves. Desktop notifications too.

RESULTS
A public record of every alert.

Each tool keeps its own record: closing line value at the alert and two minutes later, wins, losses, units and return, cut by league, venue and signal. Every play is marked proven, promising, early or avoid from its own sample, so you can see what works before you trust it.

02 / HOW IT WORKS
From signal to bet in three steps.
01
We watch the markets

The app scans Polymarket, Kalshi, sportsbooks and esports boards around the clock, and grades the traders behind the biggest bets.

02
You get the play

When something clears the bar, it lands on Best Plays with the price, the edge and a size in units. Everyone gets the same alert.

03
You decide and place it

You place the bet yourself on your own account. The app grades the alert either way, so the record stays honest.

03 / LIVE RECORD
We grade every alert twice.

First against the close: if you keep getting a better price than the market settles on, you win over time. Then against the price two minutes after the alert, because an edge that is gone by the time you click is not one you can bet. Exchange signals have to pass both before they alert.

After 2 min is the same grade at the price available two minutes later; "not graded yet" means that play has no two-minute grade so far. 01 / PRODUCT
Everything a sharp checks before betting, on one screen.

Built for prediction exchanges and esports, the two markets the big odds screeners mostly ignore.

EXCHANGE EDGES
Graded on the price you could actually get.

Line Reaper reads the deep book's fair price, adds each venue's fee, and flags Kalshi and Polymarket US prices that lag it. Most screeners stop there. We then check the price one, two and five minutes after the alert, because that is what a subscriber really gets.

Every alert graded at the moment it fired and again two minutes later
Record cut by signal and venue, losers included, all public
A signal alerts only after its own two-minute record is positive
Signals that don't hold up are held back and say so
BEST PLAYS
One ranked list.

The strongest plays across every tool, ranked by what the track record says is working. Plays the record says to avoid never make the list.

ARBS AND MIDDLES
Locked profit, fees included.

Cross-exchange and multi-outcome arbitrage, middles on totals and spreads, and bid-then-hedge plans that turn a resting order into an arb.

ODDS SCREEN
Every venue on one row.

Pinnacle's no-vig fair next to Kalshi, Polymarket US, Gemini, FanDuel, BetRivers and the big books on every game, the best price marked, and a chart of how each line moved. One tap shows only the venues legal in Texas.

SHARP TAIL
See what the biggest accounts bet.

Polymarket trades are public, so we grade accounts on return, sample size and a luck test, and watch Kalshi for whale-sized orders. Following them has not beaten the close in our own tests, and its record says so: it is a research tool, not a signal to copy.

ESPORTS
Every prop, every app, priced.

CS2, League of Legends, Valorant and Dota 2 props, and the sports boards, across PrizePicks, Underdog, Sleeper and DK Pick6, priced against Pinnacle and the books, with what each slip pays and needs to break even.

TOOLS AND MY BETS
The math, done for you.

Thirteen calculators: EV and Kelly, no-vig, arbs, hedges, middles, parlays, free bets, boosts, CLV, exchange fees and every pick'em app's payouts and break-even. Log your bets and slips and see your CLV.

ALERTS
On your phone.

Add Line Reaper to your home screen and turn on push alerts, so a play reaches you before the market moves. Desktop notifications too.

RESULTS
A public record of every alert.

Each tool keeps its own record: closing line value at the alert and two minutes later, wins, losses, units and return, cut by league, venue and signal. Every play is marked proven, promising, early or avoid from its own sample, so you can see what works before you trust it.

02 / HOW IT WORKS
From signal to bet in three steps.
01
We watch the markets

The app scans Polymarket, Kalshi, sportsbooks and esports boards around the clock, and grades the traders behind the biggest bets.

02
You get the play

When something clears the bar, it lands on Best Plays with the price, the edge and a size in units. Everyone gets the same alert.

03
You decide and place it

You place the bet yourself on your own account. The app grades the alert either way, so the record stays honest.

03 / LIVE RECORD
We grade every alert twice.

First against the close: if you keep getting a better price than the market settles on, you win over time. Then against the price two minutes after the alert, because an edge that is gone by the time you click is not one you can bet. Exchange signals have to pass both before they alert.
